_schema: Prefix variants to attach to EXISTING roots in data/verbs.json. Present forms are derived from the base root's conjugation. praet = 6 base forms or ich-form string (regular).

sent.de: Ich _____ den Drucker an den Computer _____.
sent.en: I connect the printer to the computer.
Are you joining our group?

sent.de: Er _____ das Kabel an den Fernseher _____.
sent.en: He connects the cable to the TV.

attach.notes: Separable: Ich schließe das Gerät an. Reflexive 'sich anschließen' + Dativ = to join: 'Ich schließe mich euch an.'

sent.en: The weather report predicts rain for tomorrow.
Nobody can predict the future.
The experts predict rising prices.

attach.notes: Separable with the double prefix 'vorher': Er sagt das Wetter vorher. Related noun: die Vorhersage (forecast).

sent.en: Nobody could foresee the accident.
I already foresee big difficulties.
He foresees the consequences precisely.

attach.notes: Separable: Er sieht Probleme vorher. Related adjective: vorhersehbar (foreseeable, predictable).

sent.de: Ich _____ eine Playlist für die Party _____.
sent.en: I put together a playlist for the party.

sent.de: Sie _____ das Menü für die Hochzeit _____.
sent.en: She puts together the menu for the wedding.
We still have to compile the documents.

attach.notes: Separable: Ich stelle die Liste zusammen. Related noun: die Zusammenstellung (compilation).

sent.de: Man darf Preis nicht mit Wert _____.
sent.en: One must not equate price with value.
He equates silence with agreement.
Many people equate success with money.

attach.notes: Separable. gleichsetzen = to treat as identical (mit + Dativ). Contrast gleichstellen = to give equal legal/social status.

attach.english: to give equal status / to treat as equal

sent.en: The law gives all citizens equal status.

sent.de: Der Betrieb will Teilzeitkräfte den Vollzeitkräften _____.
sent.en: The company wants to give part-time workers equal status with full-time workers.
We give both groups equal legal status.

attach.notes: Separable. gleichstellen = equal STATUS (rights, law). Contrast gleichsetzen = to claim two things are the SAME. Related noun: die Gleichstellung.

attach.english: to factor out / to exclude from a calculation

sent.en: The statisticians factor out seasonal effects.
I factor out the VAT.
One has to factor out inflation.

attach.notes: Separable: Wir rechnen den Effekt heraus. Common in statistics and data journalism.

attach.english: to agree on / to arrange; to take off

sent.de: Wir _____ einen Termin für nächste Woche _____.
sent.en: We arrange an appointment for next week.
I take the price tag off the present.

sent.de: Er _____ mit ihr ein geheimes Zeichen _____.
sent.en: He agrees on a secret signal with her.

attach.notes: Separable. Two meanings: arrange/agree ('einen Termin abmachen') and remove ('das Etikett abmachen'). 'Abgemacht!' = Deal! (see Ausdrücke).

attach.english: to belong to / to be a member of (+ Dativ)

sent.en: I don't belong to any political party.
He has been a member of the board for years.
These countries belong to the EU.

attach.notes: Separable, takes the Dativ: Ich gehöre dem Verein an. Contrast gehören + Dativ = possession ('Das Buch gehört mir'), angehören = membership.

sent.en: The city is changing quickly.
I'm not changing anything about my plan.
You haven't changed at all!

attach.notes: Inseparable: Ich verändere mich. ändern = change something concrete (plans, rules); verändern = transform, often reflexive ('sich verändern').

attach.english: to refer to (sich beziehen auf) / to obtain / to move into

sent.de: Meine Frage _____ sich auf den letzten Punkt.
sent.en: My question refers to the last point.

sent.de: Wir _____ nächsten Monat die neue Wohnung.
sent.en: We are moving into the new apartment next month.
What exactly are you referring to?

attach.notes: Inseparable. Key pattern: 'sich beziehen auf' + Akkusativ = to refer to. Also: eine Rente beziehen (to draw a pension), eine Wohnung beziehen (to move in).

attach.english: to feel comfortable / to feel at ease (sich wohlfühlen)

sent.de: Ich _____ mich in meiner neuen Wohnung sehr _____.
sent.en: I feel very comfortable in my new apartment.
Do you feel at ease at the company?

sent.de: Die Gäste sollen sich bei uns _____.
sent.en: The guests should feel at ease with us.

attach.notes: Always reflexive: sich wohlfühlen. Separable: Ich fühle mich hier wohl. Related noun: das Wohlbefinden.
